*Feature proposal template for enhancing the DEEN Commerce mobile user experience.*

## 🧐 Problem Statement

Is your feature request related to a problem or user friction?  
*Example: As a shopper, I find it cumbersome to manually type credit card numbers on mobile checkout.*

---

## 💡 Proposed Solution

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.  
*Example: Integrate native Google Pay via Capacitor so Android users can complete checkout with a single tap.*

---

## 🔄 Alternatives Considered

A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

---

## 🎨 User Experience Impact

- How will this change affect new vs. returning shoppers?
- Does this require any native Android permissions (`CAMERA`, `POST_NOTIFICATIONS`, etc.)?

---

## 🚦 Priority

- [ ] **P0 - Critical / Blocker** (Directly impacts revenue or core navigation)
- [ ] **P1 - High** (Significantly improves conversion or engagement)
- [ ] **P2 - Medium** (Nice to have quality of life improvement)
- [ ] **P3 - Low** (Minor visual tweak or future exploration)

---

## 📎 Additional Context

Add any other context, screenshots, or mockups about the feature request here.
